class.name: FallingMode
class.brief_description: In the air, under gravity, with whatever steering the game allows.
class.description: Sideways and vertical are solved separately, because they answer to different things: sideways is steering under [member CharacterMovementComponent.air_control], vertical is gravity and nothing else. [member CharacterMovementComponent.air_control] is a fraction of the ground acceleration rather than a speed of its own, so a character that accelerates hard on the ground also turns harder in the air - usually what a designer means, and one number to tune instead of two that drift apart. Landing hands back to [WalkingMode], but only while descending: clipping the top of a ramp on the way up is a graze, and treating it as a landing would cut a jump short.
